Open to the public with no registration or training: pick a dog at a participating campus (West Chester, Plymouth Meeting or Lancaster in PA, plus Delaware and DC sites) Tue-Fri 12-4 pm or Sat-Sun 11 am-2 pm and return it the same day one hour before closing.
